Strategy: No conjugate points makes exp_p a local diffeomorphism. Pull back g and use Gauss lemma: every curve from 0 to v has pulled-back length at least |v| and the radial segment attains it, so closed metric balls about 0 are Euclidean-compact and the pullback metric is complete. Apply the complete-local-isometry covering theorem. T_pM is simply connected, so it is universal; a connected cover of simply connected M has one sheet. Sources: Datar §§20.1 and 24.3, pp.147–149, 178–179; Eschenburg §5, pp.17–19.
